reviewed_by: Codex focused review of chat focus and companion geometry
reason: Only focus-mode layout CSS and its browser regression changed. The selected empty-chat journey opens the Code companion through Chat tools on desktop, enters focus, checks that chat and editor keep their side-by-side geometry, exits focus, and checks restoration. The mobile cases check that the empty chat fills focus mode without clipping. The eight permanent browser profiles cover desktop Chromium at 1440 and 1024 px plus emulated mobile Chromium and WebKit at 320, 390, and 430 px. The changed ui.css and browser test are shared paths, so this is an explicit scoped review rather than automatic broad coverage.
exclusions: No Python, Rust, API, persistence, or component state changed. A component test cannot measure the CSS grid regression. Real-Core, LAN-origin security checks, unrelated browser journeys, and full suites are excluded because this change only affects local presentation; a production build and focused browser journey will verify the built UI. Physical devices are unavailable and are not claimed.
